def display_window(self):
        """Read the channel name from QComboBox and plot its spectrum.

        This function is necessary it reads the data and it sends it to
        self.display. When the user selects a smaller chunk of data from the
        visible traces, then we don't need to call this function.
        """
        self.display.clear_plot()
        self.display.set_title(self.channel_name)
        if self.channel_name == "None":
            return
        self.display.set_xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
        self.display.set_ylabel("Amplitude (V)")
        self.display.set_xlim(self.display_frequency_range)
        self.display.set_ylim(self.display_amplitude_range)
        self.display.set_xscale("log")
        self.display.set_yscale("log")
        self.display.plot(self.channel_frequency, self.channel_amplitude)
